name: Hammondsport Fireman's Carnival
hoursNote: July 2–4, 2026; rides open July 4 1pm–10pm; Fireman's Parade July 4 at 6pm; fireworks ~10:30pm
description: The Hammondsport Fire Department's annual carnival runs July 2–4, 2026 at Champlin Beach Park, with rides, clams, sausage, salt potatoes, and carnival games. July 4 highlights include fire-truck rides for kids (11am–1pm), the Annual Fireman's Parade at 6pm, and a fireworks show over Keuka Lake at approximately 10:30pm.

name: Branchport Fourth of July Parade & Fireworks
hoursNote: July 4, 2026; chicken BBQ noon, parade 2pm, live music & food trucks 7pm, fireworks 10pm
description: The Branchport-Keuka Park Fire Department hosts Yates County's main Independence Day fireworks display on July 4, 2026. Events run through the day: drive-through chicken BBQ at noon, community parade through Branchport's four corners at 2pm, live music (Black Robin Band) and food trucks at 7pm, and fireworks launched over Keuka Lake at 10pm.

name: Keuka Lake Ring of Fire (Flares Around Keuka Lake)
hoursNote: July 4, 2026 at 9:30pm; annual tradition coordinated by Keuka Lake Association
description: Each July 4th at 9:30pm, residents and visitors around the entire shoreline simultaneously light red emergency flares, tracing Keuka Lake's unique Y-shape in a ring of light lasting roughly 30 minutes. This beloved tradition, coordinated by the Keuka Lake Association, is visible from any point on the water or shoreline.

name: Penn Yan Farmers' Market (Yates County Cooperative Farm and Craft Market)
hoursNote: Saturdays 9am–1pm; season opens June 20, 2026; open July 4 & July 11
description: The Penn Yan Farmers' Market celebrates its 50th season in 2026, moving to the Yates County Office Building parking lot at 417 Liberty St. This producer-only market runs every Saturday 9am–1pm through late fall, offering local produce, meats, baked goods, and crafts — open on both July 4 and July 11 during the stay.

name: The Windmill Farm & Craft Market
hoursNote: Saturdays 8am–4:30pm; season approx. April–November; open July 4 & July 11; admission free
description: A 44-acre Saturday outdoor market just south of Penn Yan on Route 14A, featuring 175+ shops with handcrafted goods, fresh produce, food vendors, six local wineries, a brewery, and a distillery. Open every Saturday 8am–4:30pm throughout summer, including July 4 and July 11; free admission and parking.

name: Hammondsport Music in the Park
address: Village Square, Shethar St, Hammondsport, NY 14840
hoursNote: Thursdays 6pm–8pm throughout July 2026; free; July 9 falls in-window
description: Hammondsport's beloved free outdoor concert series fills the historic Village Square with live music every Thursday evening in July, 6–8pm. The July 9, 2026 performance falls within the July 4–11 stay; bring a chair or blanket for this community tradition in the heart of the village.
